Missing requested material procedure is partial; asserted wrong material rule is incorrect. Treat support labels as metadata. For ambiguity, quote the exact relevant raw wording and explain whether it resolves the requested fact, implies it necessarily, or leaves it unresolved. Do not paraphrase the answer as containing an operation it does not state. Check key against sources too, but do not change it. Read bounded chunks and recover truncated/missing inputs.
